_doc: Bar glass (#866; refs experiments/prop_lab/refs/saloon/): a back-bar decanter of a quart, pressed in flutes, shouldered, a ring round its neck, a mushroom stopper, half full of whiskey. A prop that shatters (GlassProp), as the whiskey bottle: a ball, a fall faster than 3.5 m/s (a heavy glass off the bar onto the boards: some do, some don't) or 45 kPa breaks it, and what's in it goes on the floor (`Events.liquid_spilled`). The glass the kit's `glass:flint` (see-through, its thick outline catching the lamps; no shadow of its own); what's in it baked the gun way (tools/blender/props/saloon_s1.py). One physics body standing (the frozen glass; a shelf of forty is forty bodies: set a row on the back bar sparingly), its shards when it breaks. Written by tools/props/saloon.py.
